name: Two publication dates per record (print vs electronic)

origin.campaign: September 2026 — PubMed substrate and other corpora (Voûte)

seen.corpus: PubMed/MEDLINE baseline frozen 2026-08-18 (39,994,988 records) (pub.an/mois and elec), working table (mois, mois_e)
seen.observer: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), session 8d9c5098, from the Substrat measurement files
seen.excerpt: Règle de lecture consignée le 05-09-2026 : « an·12 + (CASE WHEN mois>0 THEN mois WHEN mois_e>0 THEN mois_e ELSE 1 END) » ; année de publication max observée dans la table de travail : 2027 (08-09-2026 : « (2027, 188900) » = 188 900 notices datées 2026, et des notices datées 2027 par avance de parution).
seen.excerpt_en: Reading rule recorded on 2026-09-05: "year·12 + (CASE WHEN month>0 THEN month WHEN month_e>0 THEN month_e ELSE 1 END)"; maximum publication year observed in the working table: 2027 (2026-09-08: "(2027, 188900)" = 188,900 records dated 2026, and records dated 2027 by advance publication).

prevention.note: not assessed by the observer; to be classified by the second reader

repair.note: deletion cannot restore this; derived from the damage class by the migration of 2026-09-09, not judged form by form and not measured — the bench can measure it

measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

history.event: proposed by the Voûte Claude in 'FORMES-PUBMED-pour-Fault-Atlas (09-09-2026)' (part 1; final file sha256 51a338add43cd071…), form 8 of 23; effect on a graph: Two possible months for the same fact; records 'from the future' (volume year after the freeze); a missing month replaced by January falsifies the month of birth. Prevalence: seen; share of records with missing month not counted.
history.by: Claude Voûte (LLM agent), session 8d9c5098, from the Substrat measurement files

history.event: converted to a record; class, prevention and the novel/variant question left to the second reader

proposed_severity.reason: two dates per record, print and electronic: taking the wrong one shifts by months, in silence
proposed_severity.status: proposed — a second reader confirms or contests, as for the 43 validated forms
proposed_severity.note: this reading agrees with how the August catalogue judges most WRONG_VALUE forms (G2), so it adds little

registry_scope.extent: every record carrying both a print and an electronic date
registry_scope.why_not_a_prevalence: a fault of a registry has no prevalence: it is a property of the base, so everything drawn from that base carries it. What can be stated is the slice it touches.
registry_scope.source: read from this form's own observation, 2026-09-11
